==>  Preparing: -- 步骤1：查询所有已装箱发货单对应的发货任务记录，统计每个待发明细的累计发货量（不关注员工身份信息） WITH shipped AS ( SELECT atd.awaiting_details_code, SUM(COALESCE(atd.this_count, 0)) AS shipped_total FROM dm_m9.production_t_dm_m9_awaiting_task_details_9 atd INNER JOIN dm_m9.production_t_dm_m9_invoice_order_9 io ON io.primary_key = atd.invoice_order WHERE atd.enterprise_code = ? AND atd.delete_flag = false AND io.enterprise_code = ? AND io.delete_flag = false AND io.packaged = true GROUP BY atd.awaiting_details_code ) -- 步骤2：关联待发明细表，按产品分组统计总累计发货量和总需发货量 SELECT ad.product_code AS productCode, ad.product_name AS productName, COALESCE(SUM(sh.shipped_total), 0) AS shippedTotal, SUM(COALESCE(ad.product_quantity, 0)) AS quantityTotal FROM dm_m9.production_t_dm_m9_awaiting_details_9 ad LEFT JOIN shipped sh ON sh.awaiting_details_code = ad.primary_key WHERE ad.enterprise_code = ? AND ad.delete_flag = 'f' AND ad.product_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ad.product_code, ad.product_name

==>  Preparing: -- 步骤1：查询当前年范围内所有已装箱发货单对应的发货任务记录，统计每个待发明细的累计发货量 -- 参考 AwaitingGoodsServiceImpl.awaitingGoodsPageList() 方法，使用 invoiceOrder.create_time 作为时间过滤字段 WITH shipped AS ( SELECT atd.awaiting_details_code, SUM(COALESCE(atd.this_count, 0)) AS shipped_total FROM dm_m9.production_t_dm_m9_awaiting_task_details_9 atd INNER JOIN dm_m9.production_t_dm_m9_invoice_order_9 io ON io.primary_key = atd.invoice_order WHERE atd.enterprise_code = ? AND atd.delete_flag = false AND io.enterprise_code = ? AND io.delete_flag = false AND io.packaged = true AND io.create_time IS NOT NULL AND io.create_time >= ? AND io.create_time <= ? GROUP BY atd.awaiting_details_code ), -- 步骤2：查询当前年范围内已签约的销售合同对应的待发明细（用于统计需发货量） -- 对于在当前年范围内已经签约过的销售合同订单（state IN ('MUTUAL_SIGN', 'UNILATERAL_SIGN', 'SEALED')）内的产品， -- 即使没有发货记录，也需要添加到统计需发货产品数量 signedContracts AS ( SELECT sc.primary_key AS contract_code FROM dm_m9.sell_t_dm_m9_sell_contract_9 sc WHERE sc.enterprise_code = ? AND sc.delete_flag = 'f' AND sc.state IN ('MUTUAL_SIGN', 'UNILATERAL_SIGN', 'SEALED') AND sc.contract_time IS NOT NULL AND sc.contract_time >= ? AND sc.contract_time <= ? ) -- 步骤3：统计当前年时间段内总累计发货量和总需发货量 -- 已发货数量：统计有发货记录的产品 -- 需发货数量：统计所有在当前年范围内已签约的销售合同订单内的产品，不管是否有发货记录 SELECT NULL AS productCode, NULL AS productName, COALESCE(SUM(sh.shipped_total), 0) AS shippedTotal, SUM(COALESCE(ad.product_quantity, 0)) AS quantityTotal FROM dm_m9.production_t_dm_m9_awaiting_details_9 ad INNER JOIN signedContracts sc ON sc.contract_code = ad.contract_code LEFT JOIN shipped sh ON sh.awaiting_details_code = ad.primary_key WHERE ad.enterprise_code = ? AND ad.delete_flag = 'f'
